texts.zh: 我们收到消息，一群来自[subject_empire.GetName]的朝圣者想方设法来到了我们的宇域。看上去他们相信[overlord_empire.GetName]在他们的家园代表了某种宗教上的重要性。尽管有关他们宗教信仰方面的细节尚不清楚，但这群人作为旅客举止十分得体，在停留期间人们对他们只有点赞，没有差评。
texts.en: Word has reached us of a group of pilgrims from the [subject_empire.GetName], making their way through our space. It seems they believe the [overlord_empire.GetName] holds some religious significance for their homeland. Though the details of their religious conviction remain obscure, they are fairly well-behaved tourists and we have heard nothing but good things about their stay here.

label.zh: 看上去，这是一次表现善意的机会。
label.en: A show of goodwill, it seems.

texts.zh: 一队前往[overlord_empire.GetName]的[overlord_empire.Capital.GetName]旅行的平民终于返回了，满载着各种奇闻轶事，讲述他们遇到的人们和当地的情况。看样子，我们的人民在旅访期间受到了热情的款待，现在越来越多的人愿意欣然前往此地旅行。如果我们能够对宗主国略施影响，我们或许可以让类似的文化交流举办得更加频繁。
texts.en: A group of civilians who traveled to [overlord_empire.Capital.GetName] in the [overlord_empire.GetName] have finally returned, with stories and tales of the people they met and what it was like. It seems our people have been treated surprisingly well while they were visiting, and now many more are interested in traveling there themselves. If we were to exert some influence on our overlord, we might be able to make these cultural exchanges a more frequent occurrence.

label.zh: 不过是一时兴起的热度罢了。
label.en: Nothing more than a short-lived craze.

texts.zh: 第一批到访的朝圣者团体十分友好，带来了善意。不仅限于此，看上去[subject_empire.GetName]投入了部分资源，希望将这样的活动上升为一种永久的双边关系，今后他们将以更加正规的基础派出朝圣者。
texts.en: Not only was the original group of pilgrims who came here friendly and well meaning, but it seems the [subject_empire.GetName] has invested some of their resources into trying to turn it into a more permanent relation, one where they will send pilgrims our way on a regular basis.

texts.zh: 在[overlord_empire.Capital.GetName]上被我们接收的朝圣者团体收到了热情款待，他们也在停留期间十分尽兴。然而，我们依然收到消息称[subject_empire.GetName]将在今后停办这样的交流访问活动。
texts.en: Though the group of pilgrims we received on [overlord_empire.Capital.GetName] were treated well and seemed to enjoy their stay, we have heard that the [subject_empire.GetName] is clamping down on such travel in the future.
